title: playerhead_fron_bone_head
description: Skeleton skeletons can be obtained by burning player or zombie heads in a furnace.
body:
With this mod, you can get a skeleton head by burning a player's head or a zombie's head in a furnace.
As an added bonus, you can get a wither spawn egg by arranging the blocks on the workbench in the same way as you would to summon the wither. The same goes for iron golems and snow golems.
This mod is licensed under CC-BY SA4.0.
## Japanese
ゾンビの頭をかまどで焼くとスケルトンの頭を入手できます。
スケルトンの頭蓋骨をウィザーローズ4つで囲むと、ウィザースケルトンの頭蓋骨ができます。 
このMODはCC-BySA4.0のライセンスで提供されています。
